privacy.intro: This policy explains how Aurelia Labs LLC handles information in the Moonplan iPhone app and on this website. Moonplan does not require an account. Its lunar calculations and activity planner run on your device.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Aurelia Labs LLC, 30 N Gould St #60794, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States, is responsible for the information we process. Contact us at admin@aurelialabs.io for privacy questions or requests.

sections.title: Information on your device
paragraphs: The app stores your selected city, that city’s coordinates and time zone, language, onboarding status and Japanese calendar preferences locally. These settings and generated lunar images are shared with Moonplan’s own widgets through an iOS App Group on the same device. They are used to display the calendar, local times and widgets.

Activity searches and planning calculations are processed locally. Moonplan does not send these searches or your calendar usage to Aurelia Labs. We do not operate an app account database, advertising trackers, analytics SDKs or a remote AI service in Moonplan. The app does not request access to your device’s GPS location, contacts, photos or microphone.

sections.title: City search and Apple services
paragraphs: When you search for a city, the text you enter is sent to Apple’s geocoding service to find coordinates and a time zone. This needs an internet connection. Apple may process the network and technical information needed to provide that service. Avoid entering a home address or other personal information when a city name is sufficient. You can skip searching and use the default city.

Apple independently operates the App Store, TestFlight, device backups and optional system diagnostics. Your use of those services and any diagnostic information you choose to share are governed by Apple’s settings and Privacy Policy. We do not receive your Apple account password. Removing the app does not itself delete information held independently by Apple.

sections.title: This website
paragraphs: This website does not set advertising or analytics cookies, run visitor analytics or use browser storage to build a profile. Fonts, scripts and screenshots are served with the website. Language selection uses ordinary links rather than tracking cookies.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub processes technical requests to deliver the site and records visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes. See GitHub’s Privacy Statement. Its retention and international transfer practices apply to that infrastructure data. Following an external link takes you to a service with its own privacy practices.

sections.title: When you contact us
paragraphs: If you email us, we receive your email address, your message, any attachments and normal email metadata. We use this information to answer your question, investigate the issue or handle your privacy request. Our email service providers process the message to deliver and store it. We do not use support messages for advertising or sell them.

Send only the information necessary for your request. We keep correspondence only for as long as needed to resolve and follow up on the request, or meet an applicable legal obligation. You can ask us to delete it; if we must retain part of it, we will explain why.

sections.title: Purposes, legal grounds and sharing
paragraphs: Where European data protection law applies, we process information needed to answer a service request to perform a contract or take steps at your request (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Resolving technical issues, protecting our services and managing correspondence may rely on our legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)); compliance with legal duties relies on Article 6(1)(c). If a feature requires consent, we will ask separately and allow you to withdraw it.

We share information only as needed with providers who help deliver the relevant service, or where a valid legal obligation requires it. We require service providers acting on our behalf to protect personal information and use it only for the agreed purpose. Apple and GitHub also process information independently under their own policies. Aurelia Labs is based in the United States; email and infrastructure providers may process information in other countries. Where required, transfers must use applicable safeguards such as approved contractual clauses or another lawful transfer mechanism. Contact us for information about safeguards relevant to your request.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local preferences remain until you change them or remove the app’s data. To remove local Moonplan data, delete the app rather than offloading it, and remove its widgets. iOS backups, if enabled on your device, are managed through your Apple settings and may retain a separate copy. We cannot remotely read or erase data stored only on your device.

You do not need to request account deletion because Moonplan has no user accounts. For support correspondence held by us, contact admin@aurelialabs.io. For information held independently by Apple or GitHub, use the controls or contact details in their respective privacy policies.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or a portable copy of personal information we hold about you, and object to certain processing. You may withdraw consent where processing relies on it, without affecting earlier lawful processing. We may need enough information to verify that a request is yours. We will respond within the period required by applicable law.

You may also complain to a competent data protection authority. These rights do not require you to create an account. Because we cannot identify local app use, we may have no app usage records to provide.

sections.title: Children and policy updates
paragraphs: Moonplan is a general audience calendar and does not ask children to create accounts or provide personal details. If you believe a child has sent personal information to us through support, contact us so we can address the request and delete information where required.

We will update this page when our practices change and revise the date above. Material changes will be communicated as required by applicable law. Adding a feature that needs consent will not be treated as permission granted by merely updating this policy.

terms.intro: These terms describe the Moonplan website and the information presented in the Moonplan app, provided by Aurelia Labs LLC. They supplement, and do not replace, the licence that applies to an app downloaded from Apple’s App Store.

sections.title: Provider and contact
paragraphs: Moonplan is provided by Aurelia Labs LLC, 30 N Gould St #60794, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States. For product support or questions about these terms, email admin@aurelialabs.io.

sections.title: What Moonplan provides
paragraphs: Moonplan presents lunar phases, astronomical calculations, calendar information, a lunar atlas and activity suggestions based on cultural traditions. Dates and times depend on the city, time zone and settings selected in the app. Calculations and reference data may contain approximations or errors; actual visibility also depends on local conditions.

Planning suggestions express traditional interpretations. They are not scientifically established effects, professional advice or guarantees of success. Use your own judgement and reliable specialist sources for decisions involving health, safety, legal matters or finances. Moonplan is not a navigation or safety tool.

sections.title: App licence and Apple
paragraphs: For an app distributed through the App Store, Apple’s Standard End User Licence Agreement applies unless a different licence is expressly supplied with that app. These website terms do not replace that agreement or change Apple’s usage rules. Apple is not the publisher of Moonplan. Product questions should be sent to Aurelia Labs.

The website currently presents a preview of Moonplan. Screenshots show sample dates and settings; they are not a live report of the Moon above your current location. Availability and supported features may vary by app version and region.

sections.title: Using the website and content
paragraphs: You may use the website to learn about Moonplan and contact support. Do not attempt to compromise its security, disrupt access, misuse the support address or infringe others’ rights. These terms do not restrict uses permitted by applicable law.

The Moonplan name, original design and original content belong to Aurelia Labs or their respective rights holders. Fonts, software components and reference material may have separate licences. See the credits and sources. Do not imply endorsement by Apple, NASA or another source.

sections.title: Availability and future purchases
paragraphs: This website does not take payments or enrol you in a subscription. No price, trial period or paid plan is offered here. If paid features are introduced, the applicable price, duration, renewal and cancellation terms will be shown before a purchase. A future policy update does not authorise a charge.

sections.title: Accuracy and your rights
paragraphs: We aim to keep Moonplan and its information useful and accurate, but do not promise uninterrupted availability or error free calculations. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the website and its informational content are provided as available. App warranties and liability are governed by the applicable app licence and mandatory law.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability where it cannot lawfully be excluded, limits mandatory consumer rights, or removes legal remedies available in your place of residence. If an issue arises, you can contact us, but doing so is not a condition for exercising your legal rights.

sections.title: Privacy and changes
paragraphs: Read our Privacy Policy for how information is handled. We may update these terms as the product changes, with a revised date on this page and any notice required by law. Changes do not retroactively remove rights you already have.
